info.description:
### Global requirements:
- Use JSON (UTF-8)
- Consumers should be open for extensions:
  - they should ignore new JSON fields
  - when possible, they should allow new values in enumerated fields
    - Headers:
        - Standard headers:
            - `Content-Type` is required when a request body is provided, and optional when not. `application/json` is the only supported value
        -  Traceability headers should be passed :
            - `X-Request-Id`: unique request ID (eg. UUID)
            - `X-Action-Id`: unique request ID (eg. UUID). For synchronous ops only
            - `X-Message-Id`: unique message ID (to reuse in case of retry)
            - `X-Process`: human readable action name
            - `X-Source`: client name with pattern `<systemName>.<appName>`
        - Both server and client must simply ignore extra headers

 ### Cross-Origin Resource Sharing:
 This API features Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) implemented in compliance with  [W3C spec](https://www.w3.org/TR/cors/).
 And that allows cross-domain communication from the browser.
 All responses have a wildcard same-origin which makes them completely public and accessible to everyone, including any code on any site.

 ### Acces :
 the access to the API depend on the type of caller:
 - In the case of a **PFM backend (APIM,...)** , access is made on __the private apiGateway of DALi system__ and secured using the __API key and mutual TLS__.
 - In the case of a __fontend (Devices: STB,APP Mobile,TV,...)__ , access is made on __the APIM apiGateway__ and secured using a __basic Authentifcation and a Bearer Token__.
info.title: DALI Offer Management API

tags.description:
### User functionality
The Offer Management Service exposes its API for realizing the following tasks:
 - Gets properties.
 - subscribe offer.
 - unsubscribe offer.
 ### Changelog :
  - 1.0.0: 
      - `Add API Offer Management`
  - 1.1.0: 
    - `Header x-kaltura-secret removed`
    - `HTTP CODE 304 removed from GET`
      - `New errors added on Unsubscribe / Subscribe methods`
    - `Unsubscribe / Subscribe methods signatures modification`
    - `Offer model :`
      - `Fields cardinality update`
      - `Fields description update`
      - `liveShop.lcn field type changed to integer`
      - `commercial.type field removed`
      - `image.type field added`
      - `image.aspectRatio field type changed to double`
      - `shortName field renamed to shortTitle`
      - `longName field renamed to longTitle`
      - `actions removed in list return (no possible action at list level)`
  - 2.0.0: 
      - `Available if X-version header is set to 2`
      - `OfferItem: new category UNMANAGED_APPLICATION`
      - `ApplicationOfferItem: new attributes commercialOffer, subscriptionType, activationLink, infoPageTemplate and hide`
      - `MultiOfferItem: new attribute commercialOffer`
      - `UnmanagedApplicationOfferItem: new offer item (available only in the list operation)`
      - `List operation: query parameter category is replaced by categories`
      - `CommercialOfferSubscribe: new attribute partner`
  - 2.1.0: 
      - `CommercialType: new commercial type PARTNER_SERVICE`
      - `ApplicationOfferItem: new attribute finalActivationLink`
      - `Partner: id field changes from mandatory to optional`
      - `Partner: status field changes from optional to mandatory`
      - `OfferItem: Fields (subscriptionType, activationLink) description update`
      - `OfferItemModel: Fields (actions, links.self) description update`
      - `New error added: HTTP CODE 400 ENTITLEMENTSTATE_MISMATCH on a GET list`
  - 2.2.0: 
      - `OfferItem: remove attributes longTitle and longDescription`
      - `OfferItem: new attribute shortName`
      - `ApplicationOfferItem: Change the type of subscriptionType from double to integer`
      - `OfferItemModel: Update description of the field links.self`
      - `OfferItemModel: Remove the field links.offer`
      - `Change the return of get and unsubscribe to a list of offerItem`
  - 2.3.0: 
    - `Optional header x-user-agent added on all operations`
    - `PriceLabel fields added in CommercialOffer`
    - `CustomPromoLabel added in PromotionCustom`

price.description: Amount of discount applicable for a specific Promotion (includes decimal)

durationType.description:
enumerated string, default=forever
Specifies the time duration for which this discount is attached to the subscription.
Possible values are :
 * one_time       :  The discount stays attached to the subscription till it is applied on an invoice once. It is removed after that from the subscription.
 * forever        :  The discount is attached to the subscription and applied on the invoices till it is explicitly removed.
 * limited_period :  The discount is attached to the subscription and applied on the invoices for a limited duration. This duration starts from the point it is applied to an invoice for the first time and expires after a period specified by period and period_unit

period.description:
min=1
The duration of time for which the discount is attached to the subscription, in period_units. Applicable only when duration_type is limited_period

periodUnit.description:
The unit of time for period. Applicable only when duration_type is limited_period.
Possible values are : 
day – A period of 24 hours.
month – A period of 1 calendar month.
year – A period of 1 calendar year
